questDefinitions.name: The Warden Must Die
questDefinitions.description: The Dead Anarchist wants the Prison Warden dead. He waits in the tower beyond the courtyard.

questDefinitions.name: Ingredients for the Circle
questDefinitions.description: The Sorcerer needs dried lavender from the Infirmary and a lowcap mushroom from the Underground Tunnels before he will let you pass.

questDefinitions.name: The Locked Mess
questDefinitions.description: The door from the Central Corridor into the Dining Hall is barred. Find another way — through the Kitchen, or get the Executioner's keyring from the Torture Chamber.

questDefinitions.name: Silence the Inquisitor
questDefinitions.description: The freed Sorcerer wants the Inquisitor destroyed before he finishes his work in the chapel.

questDefinitions.name: End the Uprising
questDefinitions.description: The Guard Captain wants the Resurrected Anarchist put down before he leads the political wing into open revolt.

locations.name: Prison Cell
locations.subtitle: Starting Cell
locations.description: Iron bars bent outward, straw scattered across the floor. A man in shackles kneels over a dead guard, and looks up at you like he already knows your name.

npcs.name: The Dead Anarchist
npcs.description: A resurrected political prisoner who points you at the Warden.
lines: You're not the one I came for. But the door's open regardless.
They buried me for a revolution I never finished. Seems I'm needed again.
The Warden still gives orders from his tower, dead or not. Kill him, and this fortress falls apart.

locations.name: Cell Block
locations.subtitle: Cell Block
locations.description: Row after row of empty cells. Someone has scratched tally marks into every door on the political prisoners' side — years of them.

locations.name: Ritual Room
locations.subtitle: Ritual Room
locations.description: A sunken circle of stone carved with wards, candles burning along every column. This is where the ritual beneath Hollowfort was cast.

npcs.name: The Sorcerer
npcs.description: The mage behind the ritual, revealed once the Demon falls.
lines: You put the demon down. Good. Now you work for me.
I need dried lavender from the Infirmary and a lowcap mushroom from the tunnels beneath.
Bring them back and I'll open the corridor. That is the only way through.
followUpLines: Lavender. Mushroom. The circle will hold a little longer.
The Inquisitor still sits on the other half of this ritual in the chapel.
Kill him, and the wards stop answering to anyone but me. The corridor is yours.

locations.name: Underground Tunnels
locations.subtitle: Underground Tunnels
locations.description: Old foundations beneath the fortress, lit by torches that shouldn't still be burning. Something skitters just out of the light.

loot.name: Lowcap Mushroom
loot.description: Pale fungus from the tunnels — a ritual ingredient

locations.name: Central Corridor
locations.subtitle: Central Corridor
locations.description: The fortress's main artery. Torches gutter over churned blood, and every door in Hollowfort seems to open off this one hall — except the mess door, which stays barred.

npcs.name: The Smuggler
npcs.description: A corridor rat who sells restoratives for crowns — no questions, no refunds.
lines: Keep your voice down. Crowns talk louder than prayers in this hall.
Shield patch or a shot of focus — pick one. I don't do charity.
You want to walk out of Hollowfort, you'll pay for the privilege of standing.

locations.name: Prison Kitchen
locations.subtitle: Prison Kitchen
locations.description: Cold ovens, spilled grain, a knife block missing every blade but one.

locations.name: Infirmary
locations.subtitle: Infirmary
locations.description: Rows of empty cots, bandages black with old blood. Whatever died here last did not stay down.

locations.name: Torture Chamber
locations.subtitle: Torture Chamber
locations.description: Chains creak with no one pulling them. The equipment here was built to make people talk — or stop them from ever talking again.

npcs.name: The Executioner
npcs.description: He offers a keyring that opens the mess door off the corridor.
lines: I hanged my own bride on the Warden's order. Called it duty, once.
That barred door into the Dining Hall? Staff keyring's on the hook. Take it.
Three doors past the courtyard: chapel, tower, political wing. Pick your poison.

loot.name: Dining Keyring
loot.description: Opens the barred door from the Central Corridor into the Dining Hall

locations.name: Guard Barracks
locations.subtitle: Guard Barracks
locations.description: Bunks overturned, foot-lockers pried open. Whoever held this room isn't holding it anymore.

locations.name: Armory
locations.subtitle: Armory
locations.description: Weapon racks toppled across the floor, suits of armor still standing at attention along the walls.

locations.name: Dining Hall
locations.subtitle: Dining Hall
locations.description: Long tables set for a meal that never happened, chandeliers still lit above the empty benches.

locations.name: Central Courtyard
locations.subtitle: Branching Courtyard
locations.description: Open sky at last, choked with smoke. Three doors face you across the stone — a chapel, a tower, and the political wing. Once you commit, the other two will seal.

npcs.name: The Guard Captain
npcs.description: Still holding the courtyard, asking you to end the Resurrected Anarchist.
lines: Still barking orders, still holding this courtyard by will alone. You're not what I expected.
The Resurrected Anarchist is stirring up the political wing. Put him down before he leads a real uprising.
Chapel, tower, political wing — choose your door. The others seal the moment you do.

quest.name: The Final Door
quest.description: Choose a path out of Hollowfort — chapel, tower, or political wing. The other two will be lost to you.

locations.name: Chapel
locations.subtitle: Final Branch · Chapel
locations.description: Candlelight over a desecrated altar. The Inquisitor kneels before it, and rises the instant he hears you.

locations.name: Warden's Tower
locations.subtitle: Final Branch · Tower
locations.description: Papers scattered everywhere, a chair overturned. The Warden himself is very much returned from the dead.

locations.name: Political Wing
locations.subtitle: Final Branch · Political Wing
locations.description: The cells where the crown kept its heretics. The Anarchist you met at the start is here too — or something wearing what's left of him.

locations.name: Exit Gate
locations.subtitle: Escape
locations.description: Sunlight through the portcullis. Whichever door you took, this is where every path out of Hollowfort ends.

npcs.name: The Dead Anarchist
npcs.description: Waiting at the gate after the Warden falls.
lines: The Warden's finished. Whatever kept this fortress standing dies with him.
Funny — I only wanted my own freedom. Seems I bought everyone's.
Go on. The gate's yours now.

npcs.name: The Sorcerer
npcs.description: Waiting at the gate after the Inquisitor falls.
lines: The Inquisitor is finished, and so is his half of the ritual.
Whatever this fortress becomes now, it won't be his design.
The gate is open. I have no further use for it.

npcs.name: The Guard Captain
npcs.description: Waiting at the gate after the Resurrected Anarchist falls.
lines: The Anarchist's revolt ends here, with him.
I kept my word. The gate is yours, prisoner.
Go — before I remember what you are.
